name: Admin Client First-Login Notification
description: When a platform client sets their password and logs in for the first time (POST /api/accounts/verify/, only when was_onboarded was False), client_flow_notifications fires a team milestone alert: an in-app notification to the project admins plus an email to the notification recipients. Best-effort; never blocks onboarding.
knownGaps: Server-triggered side-effect (in-app + email). Out of browser-E2E scope, consistent with the other system-triggered flows; may be asserted as a branch of platform-verify-onboarding.
